text:
Type: bamboo desk with three drawers
Use: working, writing, studying; home office, study, bedroom, living room corner
Style: Scandinavian, mid-century modern, minimalist
Materials: solid bamboo top and drawer fronts, white powder-coated steel legs
Colors: warm golden bamboo, white
Shape: slim box-like rectangular top with a row of three shallow drawers and small wooden knobs, thin splayed legs joined by a low rail, light and airy, compact
Feel: warm, light, natural, fresh
Goes with: white walls, light wood floors, green plants, white or wood chairs; Scandinavian or Japandi home offices
